items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: I wouldn’t need to play bass or play with Bill Evans or Stan Getz.

ctx.x: Okay, “means in its abstract way” can you extrapolate on that a little bit?

Well I don’t know what meaning there is in music and how to put into words what music means. I do understand that music makes me understand my humanity, my human existence, the things I feel and things I think about as this kind of human animal. And when I hear the music of another human animal, like me, I hear into the sensibility and experience of that person and I either feel connected and things in common with that or not. What that meaning is in words I can’t — it’s — if I could tell you what it meant in…
You wrote, “play, sing as if you could not speak.”
